topic: Access credentials and system functionality check
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on troubleshooting access to a system. Initially, [p1] reported issues with the login process. It was confirmed that while Google authentication is convenient, logging in using an email and password remains functional. The team discussed whether passwords were distributed to all members of the data team, specifically mentioning new users. A temporary solution involving password reset was noted. Later, after a deployment, it was discovered that system settings needed updating, which had been missed by the team.
decisions: The primary login method using email and password is confirmed to be functional.
action_items: Check/verify system settings post-deployment to ensure all necessary configurations are updated.
